137.body:
Delivers [MultiAgency kanban-sandbox#50](https://github.com/MultiAgency/kanban-sandbox/issues/50).

Closes MultiAgency/near-agencies#61

## What changed

Step 4 of the README's "Joining the roster" described the old path: an
owner runs `node roster.mjs add <issue>` and opens a pull request on
`roster.json`. That's no longer how it works — an owner now comments
`/admit` on the verified join request, and the coordinator's
`admitOnRequest` (`lib/coordinator.mjs`) verifies it again, registers the
account for testnet USDC, and writes it to the admitted store with
`admit()` (`lib/roster.mjs`) — live at once, with no `roster.json` deploy
needed — then closes the request.

Updated step 4 to describe that flow, and kept `node roster.mjs add <issue>`
documented as a fallback, since it still works (`roster.mjs`'s `add`
command still verifies the request and writes `roster.json` for review).

Added `test/readme.test.mjs`, which ties the README's claims to the real
function and command names, so a future rename breaks the test instead of
the docs quietly going stale again.

## Verification

- `npm ci`, `npm run check`, and `npm test` all pass (553/553 tests).
- Read `admitOnRequest` and `admit()` in `lib/coordinator.mjs` /
  `lib/roster.mjs` to confirm the described behavior (verify-again, USDC
  registration, live write, issue close) matches the code.
- Confirmed `roster.mjs`'s `add` command is unchanged and still works.
